product_metadata.title: Magic Slushy Maker Squeeze Cup Slushie Maker, Homemade Milk Shake Maker Cooling Cup Squee DIY it for Everyone (Blue)
features: 【DIY SMOOTHIE AND QUICK FREEZE】 The Frozen Principle is the cup that has a food-grade freezing liquid, no bulky equipment or electrical outlet needed. Pour any drink you like, and squeeze it, just 1-2 minutes, you get a healthy smoothie.

【FOOD GRADE MATERIAL】The slushie cups body food-grade silicone, soft and non-deformable, all parts are non-toxic, environmental protection and healthy. This frozen magic slushy maker cup is 100% safe for you and your child.Great gift choice for children.

【GREAT FAMILY ACTIVITIES】Fun for kids and adults alike, children are happily immersed in the smoothie making, use slushie cups to create a unique smoothie. No complicated steps, everyone can make smoothies at home and enjoy the process.

【EASY TO USE AND REUSABLE 】 You need to put it in the freezing layer of the refrigerator for 4-5 hours; Then pour any drink you like, squeeze it for 1-2 minutes, and you can taste the delicious smoothie! Just wash the slush cup and refreeze to start the next freezing adventure.

【2 IN 1 STRAW AND SPOON】Spoon connected to the straw, can be used as a spoon or as a straw separately, meet different needs. You can enjoy a slushy party of different flavors, perfect with juice or cola.

details.Included Components: 1× User manual, 1× Straw with spoon(2-in-1), 1× Slushy Maker Cup（Can be reassembled）, 1× Lid
